clusters.name: Faster growth, higher sales spending
clusters.description: Typical company-years in this group grew revenue by 45%. For every $100 of revenue, they spent $58 on sales and marketing and $27 on research and development. They lost $30 from operations per $100 of revenue.
clusters.tradeoff: Faster growth appears alongside higher sales spending and larger operating losses.
clusters.label_basis: Faster/slower and higher/lower compare training-group medians. These labels describe observed financials, not management intent. Each dollar figure is a separate median; they are not a reconciled budget.

clusters.name: Slower growth, lower sales spending
clusters.description: Typical company-years in this group grew revenue by 29%. For every $100 of revenue, they spent $36 on sales and marketing and $18 on research and development. They lost $11 from operations per $100 of revenue.
clusters.tradeoff: Slower growth appears alongside lower sales spending and smaller operating losses.
clusters.label_basis: Faster/slower and higher/lower compare training-group medians. These labels describe observed financials, not management intent. Each dollar figure is a separate median; they are not a reconciled budget.

selection_rule: Highest training silhouette with at least 15 rows per cluster; k=2..6.
limitations: Clusters are descriptive financial groups, not causal strategies.
Next-year outcomes never enter the clustering features.
Raw inputs remain unchanged; preprocessing applies only to clustering.
Clipping may suppress economically meaningful extremes.
